title: Manga Plus Adds KAKAKAKA, The Ura Files, Noisering, 1 More Title
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus added the following titles to its platform from late August to early September: Numa and Kuroki simulatenously launched the series in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine and on the MANGA Plus website on August 31.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Thirteenth Ending Featuring "Yume no Manual" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its thirteenth ending, featuring the song “Yume no Manual” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 154-165, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yu Hibari's Watashi de Dōtei Suteta Kuse ni Novels Get Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine announced on Tuesday that Yu Hibari 's Watashi de Dōtei Suteta Kuse ni (Even Though You Lost Your Virginity to Me) light novel series is getting a manga adaptation that will launch on September 29 on Kadokawa 's Shōnen Ace Plus…
author: ANN

title: Emma and the Eyes that Bid Farewell's Higure Sakino Launches New Manga
content: Manga author Higure Sakino announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Monday their new manga adaptation of Akane Yuzuki's Elina Sky wa Mō Machigaenai ~Saikyō Majo no Yarinaoshi Kōfuku-tan~ (Elina Sky Will Not Make Mistakes Anymore ~The Strongest Witch's Story of Starting Over and Finding Happiness~) on…
author: ANN

title: Chiruran: Shinsengumi Requiem, Rappa: Yankee Ninpū Chō Manga Artist Eiji Hashimoto Confirms Full Hearing Loss in Right Ear
content: Manga artist Eiji Hashimoto confirmed on his pixiv Fanbox page on September 15 that he has now fully lost hearing in his right ear. Hashimoto previously revealed in May that he was diagnosed with sudden sensorineural hearing loss, or sudden deafness, in April due to overwork.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man’s Anime Production Reveals Minor AI Use, But Fans Shouldn’t Worry
content: Chainsaw Man has become one of the most popular and modern shonen series of all time, with top-notch production from MAPPA and a talented team involved in various departments of the anime. One team that doesn’t get much appreciation for the development of an anime or any entertainment series is the sound department.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Returns With Anime Revival This October – Watch Trailer
content: A major Shonen Jump series is coming back with a new anime revival after it was cancelled last year, and a new trailer is showing off more of what to expect from its debut this October.
author: ComicBook

title: Magilumiere Co. Ltd. Creator Yū Aoki, Ya Boy Kongming! Creator Yuto Yotsuba Launch New Manga
content: Magilumiere Co. Ltd. creator Yū Aoki announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday that she has launched a new boat racing manga series with Ya Boy Kongming! creator Yuto Yotsuba titled Boat Girl on the Piccoma manga platform on the same day. Yotsuba is credited with the original concept.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Shares First Look & Synopsis for 2026 Finale
content: The biggest Isekai anime franchise now streaming with Crunchyroll is gearing up for its big finale for the year, and fans have gotten the first look at what to expect before it hits.
author: ComicBook

title: Kakao Entertainment to Shut Down N. American Webtoon Platform Tapas
content: The company has not announced any details regarding user refunds and the handling of content and user data. Kakao Entertainment acquired Tapas and Radish in 2021, valuing the two companies at about US$510 million and US$440, respectively. The two platforms later merged into Tapas Entertainment in 2022.
author: ANN
